name: Grove
description: Quiet editorial-serif system in the register of a literary monograph. Deep forest green canvas with warm cream text and terracotta coral accent. Playfair Display weight 400 (never bold) with italic coral emphasis, Jost 300 body, JetBrains Mono 300 labels. 1px hairline borders, em-dash bullets, watermark numerals. Generous negative space.
descriptionZh: 文学专著气质的安静编辑衬线系统。深森林绿底色配暖奶油色文字和赤陶珊瑚强调色。Playfair Display 字重 400（永不加粗）配斜体珊瑚强调，Jost 300 正文，JetBrains Mono 300 标签。1px 细线边框、破折号项目符号、水印数字。慷慨的留白空间。
bestFor: 可持续品牌 / 健康品牌
avoidFor: 需要霓虹能量或快速节奏的场景
